day.headline: A Rooster day — Ox and Snake are in step.

reasons: Dragon pairs with Rooster — a harmonious day
signs.message: Wear the mismatched pair on purpose. Nobody's asking, everyone clocks it.

reasons: Rooster's own day — your energy runs high
signs.message: That spare key fits something. Go find out this afternoon.

reasons: Ox and Rooster share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: It's been sitting unplayed since Tuesday. Press play, it's two minutes.

reasons: Rat sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the sticker that will not come off
signs.message: Hot water and a thumbnail. That gunky label comes off today.

reasons: Snake and Rooster share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: Let the crowded one go up without you. Next one's yours.

reasons: Monkey sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the person you copy without meaning to
signs.message: Her phrasing keeps coming out of your mouth. Keep the good parts.

reasons: Horse sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: That patch nobody waters is thriving anyway. Give it five minutes.

reasons: Dog sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Six files named final. Rename them properly, ten minutes, everyone's grateful.

reasons: Rabbit opposes Rooster — a day to take slowly
signs.motif: the light you always leave on
signs.message: Leave it burning tonight. Coming home to a lit room wins.

reasons: Tiger sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Four percent and the charger's upstairs. Shut the lid, stay put.

reasons: Pig sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Pockets today. Nothing in them but your hands, ideally.

reasons: Goat sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: being tired in a specific way
signs.message: This isn't sleep tired, it's screen tired. Dim the room, turn in.
